name: agent-master-3000
description: A Kanban board for OpenCode sessions, driven over the Agent Client Protocol

scripts.dev:scratch: concurrently -n server,client "PORT=3002 BOARD_STATE_FILE=data/board_state.scratch.json AGENT_MASTER_CONFIG=data/config.scratch.json npm run server" "VITE_DEV_PORT=3998 API_PORT=3002 npm run client"
scripts.server:fake: ACP_COMMAND="node tests/fixtures/fakeAgent.mjs" ACP_FAKE_SCRIPT=permission tsx watch server/index.ts
scripts.server:fake:question: ACP_COMMAND="node tests/fixtures/fakeAgent.mjs" ACP_FAKE_SCRIPT=elicitation tsx watch server/index.ts
scripts.sandbox:sh: npm run sandbox:build && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yml run --rm --service-ports board bash
scripts.sandbox:test: npm run sandbox:build && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yml run --rm test
scripts.sandbox:e2e: docker compose -f sandbox/compose.e2e.yml build && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.e2e.yml run --rm e2e
scripts.sandbox:board: npm run sandbox:build && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yml up dev
scripts.sandbox:demo: npm run sandbox:build && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yml up demo
scripts.sandbox:probe: npm run sandbox:build && docker compose -f sandbox/compose.yml run --rm board sandbox/bin/probe-tools.sh
